verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters on a base model is a fair axis for a local LLM runtime and server like LM Studio, but the evidence pack never mentions LoRA, adapters, or serving multiple adapters on one base model. It only covers loading and serving whole models (lms load, OpenAI-like endpoints, on-demand loading), which is adjacent and does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
